Callout.Name: Bear Sighting
Callout.Message: Bear reported near a campsite, campers concerned.
Callout.Advisory: Animal not aggressive, campers still on site.

Script.Line: It came into the camp about an hour ago and it has not gone far.
Nobody has been hurt. Everybody is in their tents.
It went for the food bin and then it just sat down.

Lines.Approach: It has not gone for anybody yet. Move the campers on before it changes its mind.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
